nodes.description: Global boolean gate controlling whether swapping credits is enabled; written by setEnabled and read by the isEnabled modifier.
Mapping(address => SwapOption) holding per-token swap configuration (enabled, burn, price with 18 decimals).
Owner address inherited from OwnableUpgradeable; governs all onlyOwner restricted functions.
Initializer that sets up Ownable and UUPS upgradeability; protected by the initializer modifier.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook, restricted with onlyOwner; gates all implementation upgrades.
Public view returning the SwapOption struct for a given token contract.
User-facing entry point that computes value from amount*price/1e18 and pulls/burns tokens; performs external calls before emitting CreditsChanged.
Owner-only function emitting a CreditsChanged event crediting an account without any token transfer.
Owner-only setter for per-token swap options with price bounds checks (<= uint128 max, > 0).
Owner-only withdrawal that incorrectly uses safeTransferFrom(address(this), owner, amount) instead of safeTransfer; requires allowance to self.
Owner-only toggle of the global _enabled swap gate.
Caller-controlled msg.sender accessed via _msgSender(); used as the swap account and for owner checks.
External call IERC20Burn(tokenContract).burnFrom(account, value) to an attacker-influenced token contract.
External token transfer IERC20Upgradeable(tokenContract).safeTransferFrom(account, address(this), value) inside swapTokensForCredits.
External token call IERC20Upgradeable(tokenContract).safeTransferFrom(address(this), _msgSender(), amount) inside withdrawTokens (wrong helper, breaks transfer semantics).
UUPS delegatecall to a new implementation address via upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall, executing arbitrary code in the proxy context.
int256 amount parameter of swapTokensForCredits; validated > 0 then cast to uint256.
address tokenContract parameter of swapTokensForCredits selecting the external token and swap option.
account = _msgSender() local used as the source of tokens in swapTokensForCredits.
value = (uint256(amount) * option.price) / 10**18 local computed in swapTokensForCredits.
uint256 price parameter of setTokenSwapOption, bounded and downcast to uint128 before storage.
address account parameter of giftCredits, credited via event only.
uint256 amount parameter of withdrawTokens passed directly to the token transfer call.

edges.reason: _msgSender() (msg.sender) is assigned to the local variable account in swapTokensForCredits.
amount is cast to uint256 and multiplied by option.price and divided by 10**18 to derive value.
option.price read from _tokenSwapOptions feeds the value computation amount*price/1e18.
Caller-derived account is passed as the burnFrom target to the external token contract before state is finalized.
Caller-derived account is passed as the from address of the external safeTransferFrom call.
Computed value is passed as the burn amount to the external burnFrom call.
Computed value is passed as the transfer amount to the external safeTransferFrom call.
External call into an attacker-influenced token contract can reenter swapTokensForCredits before the event/state finalization.
External safeTransferFrom on an untrusted token can reenter swapTokensForCredits.
External token call in withdrawTokens can reenter the owner-only withdrawal flow.
upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall invokes _authorizeUpgrade before performing the delegatecall-based upgrade.
onlyOwner on _authorizeUpgrade compares the caller against the _owner state variable.
msg.sender is checked against owner() in the onlyOwner guard protecting upgrades.
tokenContract is used as the key to read _tokenSwapOptions.
tokenContract determines which external token contract is called by burnFrom.
tokenContract determines which external token contract is called by safeTransferFrom in the swap.
price parameter is downcast to uint128 and stored into _tokenSwapOptions[tokenContract].price.
setTokenSwapOption writes enabled, burn and price into the _tokenSwapOptions mapping.
setEnabled writes the _enabled gate state variable.
isEnabled modifier reads _enabled to gate swapTokensForCredits execution.
tokenSwapOption view function reads _tokenSwapOptions and returns the SwapOption struct.
amount parameter of withdrawTokens is passed directly to the external token transfer call.
account parameter of giftCredits is emitted in the CreditsChanged event.
_msgSender() is recorded as the source in the giftCredits CreditsChanged event.
swapTokensForCredits depends on the initialized state set up by initialize.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter amount only exists to compute value and drive external calls within swapTokensForCredits.
Parameter tokenContract is only used to index _tokenSwapOptions and select the external token within swapTokensForCredits.
Local account is a direct alias of _msgSender() scoped to swapTokensForCredits.
Local value is the computed token amount fed into the external burn/transfer operations.
Parameter price is only validated and stored inside setTokenSwapOption.
Parameter account is only emitted in the event of giftCredits.
Parameter amount is only forwarded to the external token call inside withdrawTokens.
